rca of the issue: The 3 broken Unsplash images in IndustrySelectorMaster are likely typos/invalid hash IDs in the static URL list. Reproduction: open https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1503387762-bf76d61f7e75?auto=format&fit=crop&w=900&q=78 directly — returns 404. The numeric prefix '1503387762' is shorter than typical Unsplash IDs (10 digits vs 16). Mitigation: grab fresh IDs from unsplash.com/s/photos/{logistics|construction|schools} and update the `u(...)` calls. No code-path change needed; pure data fix in IndustrySelectorMaster.jsx lines 49, 61, 97.
